entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! This is absolutely unacceptable! I bought a pair of your mountain bike shoes a month ago and they are complete and utter garbage. I want my money back, now!
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase, sir. I definitely want to help you with this. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes?

What's the issue?! They've given me painful blisters on every ride! I've tried everything, moved the cleats around a dozen times, nothing works. They're defective. I want a full refund, and if you can't do it, get me your manager. I've spent thousands of dollars with VeloFit and this is the service I get?

I can certainly understand your frustration. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can assure you, I can handle this for you. Let me just pull up your order information. Can you please provide your email address?
It's vipcustomer@email.com. And you better handle it, because I am one click away from plastering a negative review on every cycling forum on the internet about this.

Thank you. I have your account pulled up now. I see you're a VIP member with us, and we sincerely appreciate your business. I'm just checking the return eligibility... okay, I see the shoes were delivered 35 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return policy for a full refund.
About time I heard something that makes sense. So process the refund.

Absolutely. I have just authorized the return. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email right now. Just pack the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once the tracking shows it's on its way back to us, we will process your full refund immediately. For all the trouble with the blisters and the frustrating experience, I've also gone ahead and added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account.
Wait, a full refund and a $50 credit? Well... okay then. That's... actually very helpful. I appreciate you doing that, Diana. That's good service.
Of course. We want to make sure you're taken care of. The credit is there for you whenever you're ready to try a different piece of gear. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for resolving this.
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
